title: Customer Experience Credits & Runway Simulator for Top-Account Intake
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an intake sub-system that calculates 'experience credits' for top accounts based on severity of escalations, contractual commitments and past feature impact. Use a runway simulator to convert credits into recommended admission windows and auto-admission rules for low-friction requests.
acceptance_criteria: Credits algorithm defined with weights for revenue, SLA risk, and user impact
Runway simulator produces a recommended admission date and confidence score
Auto-admit rules implemented for credits > 80 with opt-out toggle
Dashboard tile in Console that shows credits, runway and historical decisions
Integration tests between intake service and roadmap scheduler passing in staging
updates: 2025-02-20 - Asha Patel: Initial scoping and problem statement; proposed 'experience credits' concept after customer interviews with three Strategic accounts; linked PRD.

2025-02-25 - Product review: Reviewed weighting schema options (revenue-first vs risk-first) with Eng and Sales; decided to expose weights as configurable in Console + default to risk-first for enterprise tier.
2025-02-28 - Design feedback (Maya Lin): Wireframes for Console tile and admit/override flows created; requested compact summary card and inline history view.

2025-03-01 - Eng sync (Liam O'Connor): Prototype simulator implemented against synthetic backlog; found prioritization edge-case when multiple accounts request same sprint window — introduced tie-breaker by last-commitment date.

2025-03-03 - Data experiment: Runway simulator ran on 12 months of backlog; median predicted admission deviation = 6 days; two outliers discovered caused by feature dependencies — flagged for dependency graph integration (ENG-2349).
2025-03-05 - Blocker: Need schema change in intake API to include 'contract_tier' and 'escalation_impact_score' (ENG-2410). Raised with infra team; temporary fallback mapping implemented.
next_steps: Resolve intake API schema change (ENG-2410) and merge mapping fallback
Final design handoff with accessibility notes and compact card variants
Implement admin controls in Console for weight adjustments per customer cohort
Schedule closed beta with two lighthouse accounts for April cycle
risks: Over-automating admission could erode trust with account contacts; include explicit audit trail and opt-out
Weighting calibration may favor revenue and miss technical risk — require explicit penalty for cross-team dependencies
Simulator relies on accurate dependency graph which is incomplete today (ENG-2349)
decision_log: 2025-02-25 - Decision to default to risk-first weighting for enterprise tier (approved by PM, Eng, Sales)
2025-03-01 - Decision to add 'confidence score' output from simulator to inform manual overrides
2025-03-05 - Temporary decision to implement fallback mapping for missing intake fields until schema is updated
